description: Defines the implementation class for UHD-based radio sessions, including configuration, control, and management functions, as well as a factory for creating such sessions.

classes.name: radio_session_uhd_impl
classes.description: Implements a UHD radio session with management and data plane functions, including configuration, start/stop, and gain/frequency control.

classes.name: radio_factory_uhd_impl
classes.description: Factory class for creating UHD radio session instances with configuration validation.

methods.name: is_successful
methods.description: Indicates if the UHD radio session was successfully initialized.

methods.name: get_management_plane
methods.description: Returns a reference to the management plane interface.

methods.name: get_baseband_gateway
methods.description: Retrieves the baseband gateway associated with a given stream ID.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the radio session with a specified initial time.

methods.name: set_tx_gain
methods.description: Sets the transmission gain for a specified port.

methods.name: set_rx_gain
methods.description: Sets the reception gain for a specified port.

methods.name: set_tx_freq
methods.description: Sets the transmission frequency for a given stream.

methods.name: set_rx_freq
methods.description: Sets the reception frequency for a given stream.

methods.name: read_current_time
methods.description: Reads the current timestamp from the baseband gateway.

methods.name: get_configuration_validator
methods.description: Returns the configuration validator for UHD radio sessions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new UHD radio session instance with specified configuration.
